description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As Onebrief grows, our payroll operations are becoming more complex. Employees work across multiple states, and we’re introducing new systems to better support that work. We’re hiring a Payroll Manager to give payroll operations dedicated ownership and help employees get paid accurately.

You’ll own payroll across two legal entities and a multistate workforce, and help expand payroll operations internationally. Your work will help build reliable processes, give Finance better visibility into payroll, and make payroll easier for employees.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll initially report to our Manager, People Operations as you take over payroll responsibilities from the People team, then transition to reporting to the Manager, Finance Operations. Throughout that transition, you’ll partner closely with both teams to establish clear ownership and keep operations running smoothly.

What You’ll Do

  • Own accurate, timely payroll. Manage payroll preparation and processing in Rippling across two legal entities and multiple states. Coordinate inputs with People and other stakeholders, validate changes and calculations, resolve discrepancies, and prepare payroll for review. Finance retains final payroll approval and payment release.

  • Maintain reliable payroll tax administration and reporting. Manage tax settings and coordinate jurisdiction registrations and account updates. Review payroll filings, payments, and reporting for accuracy; resolve notices and discrepancies with Rippling and appropriate advisors; and coordinate quarter-end, year-end, and W-2 review. Partner with Finance on payroll reconciliations and accounting support.

  • Support international payroll expansion. Own payroll readiness and ongoing coordination with local providers as Onebrief enters new markets. Establish clear responsibilities for inputs, validation, approvals, funding, and reporting, and obtain specialist guidance when requirements fall outside your expertise.

  • Give Finance meaningful oversight. Prepare clear payroll review materials, explain significant changes and exceptions, and partner with Finance on funding, accounting entries, and reconciliations. Maintain payroll code and labor allocation mappings with People, Accounting, and FP&A so reporting remains useful as teams and organizational structures change.

  • Guide payroll integration for additional entities. Support acquisition due diligence and payroll transitions by validating employment and provider arrangements, identifying tax and data dependencies, and recommending a practical integration approach that protects payroll continuity.

  • Build processes that scale. Establish documented workflows, calendars, controls, and escalation paths. Address recurring issues, reduce manual work, and provide responsive employee support while protecting sensitive payroll and financial information.

  • Be a trusted resource for employees and partners. Investigate payroll questions, communicate clearly about corrections and unresolved issues, and handle sensitive information with discretion. Coordinate across teams and providers while remaining accountable for resolution.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Recent, hands-on experience independently preparing and processing U.S. payroll across multiple states and legal entities.

  • Strong working knowledge of payroll tax administration, filing review, reconciliations, and quarter-end and year-end processes.

  • Ability to reconcile data across systems, investigate discrepancies, and support accurate reporting.

  • Experience establishing or improving payroll controls, documentation, and cross-functional handoffs.

  • Sound judgment and clear communication, including the ability to resolve unfamiliar issues through appropriate research, provider coordination, or specialist guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience processing and administering payroll in Rippling or similar HRIS / payroll provider.

  • Experience supporting international payroll through local providers, including coordinating payroll inputs, reviewing payroll accuracy, and supporting new-country launches. Experience with the UK, Australia, or the UAE is especially relevant.

  • Experience transitioning operational ownership between teams or improving payroll processes in a growing organization.

  • Experience integrating acquired companies or additional legal entities into payroll operations, including payroll migration, tax registrations and account setup, data reconciliation, and coordination with Finance, People, and external advisors.

  • Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC) or Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) credential.

Indicators of Success

This role will evolve as priorities change, but the outcomes below reflect what success typically looks like in the first six months.

A successful Payroll Manager will:

  • Run accurate, on-time payroll with complete review materials, clear approval records, and minimal avoidable corrections.

  • Establish clear payroll ownership across People and Finance, allowing People to provide necessary employee inputs without managing routine payroll execution.

  • Give Finance a clear understanding of payroll results, significant changes, unresolved risks, and decisions requiring approval.

  • Maintain reconciled payroll records and a clear view of tax accounts, filings, and outstanding issues, with discrepancies resolved or actively managed.

  • Establish clear payroll responsibilities and readiness criteria for international operations or entity integrations as those needs arise.

Tools, Systems & Technologies

  • Rippling, Deel, Compt, Brex, Zip


Notice to Third Party Recruitment Agencies
Please note that Onebrief does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of an executed Recruitment Services Agreement, there will be no obligation to any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, shall be deemed the property of Onebrief.
